name: LangGraph Explicit State Runtime
mechanism: Executes an application-defined graph over typed state with checkpointers, resumable threads and explicit interrupts for external input or approval.
use_when: Control flow requires inspectable branches, cycles or approval suspension
Application code must own state transitions while reusing checkpoint and resume machinery
avoid_when: A short linear loop is sufficient
The team expects graph checkpointing to make arbitrary external effects exactly-once
expected_effects: Explicit inspectable workflow state and transitions
Resumable execution at declared graph boundaries
failure_modes: Thread identity or checkpoint schema is migrated incorrectly
Fine-grained graphs add debugging and synchronization overhead
